title: Ayush Shetty Stuns World No. 1 Shi Yu Qi at BWF World Championships
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty delivered a massive upset by defeating the defending world champion.
summary: Ayush Shetty, a 21-year-old Indian talent, caused a sensation at the BWF World Championships by knocking out defending champion and world No. 1 Shi Yu Qi in a thrilling three-game encounter.

title: PV Sindhu Begins World Championships Campaign with Dominant Win
indian_angle: India's five-time World Championships medalist PV Sindhu started her quest for a sixth medal with a comfortable victory.
summary: India's badminton icon PV Sindhu secured a commanding 21-7, 21-11 victory over Sophia Noble in her opening match at the BWF World Championships, eyeing a historic sixth medal.

title: BWF World Championships Return to India After 17 Years Amidst Roaring Home Crowd
indian_angle: The prestigious BWF World Championships are being hosted in New Delhi, marking a significant return for Indian badminton and providing a home advantage for shuttlers.
summary: The BWF World Championships have returned to New Delhi after a 17-year hiatus, with a passionate home crowd creating an electric atmosphere as Indian shuttlers aim for glory on familiar ground.

title: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand's Comeback Journey to World Championships
indian_angle: India's top women's doubles pair, Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand, are making their return to the World Championships after Treesa's ankle injury.
summary: After an ankle injury sidelined Treesa Jolly for months, India's leading women's doubles pair, Treesa and Gayatri Gopichand, are rebuilding their form and launching their campaign at the BWF World Championships.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: A national coaching camp for India's U17 and U15 junior badminton teams is being held in Guwahati, preparing them for upcoming Asian championships.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is hosting an Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026, focusing on developing the next generation of Indian talent.
